diagnosis: Taurus Electric has strong reviews (9, 5-star) but zero web presence—no website, email, or address listed. Missing digital storefront costs them visibility and makes booking friction high for local Denver customers searching online.
hero_angle: Perfect 5-star review record proves quality; a simple website unlocks more referrals without changing the work.
cold_message: Hey — 9 five-star reviews on Google is legit. But when someone in Denver, CO searches "electrician near me" tonight, they're booking whoever has a website. You're losing jobs to guys with half your reputation. Worth a quick fix? — Dave, Trevo Advisors
